stat.title: Misfortune Index
stat.subtitle: Close-loss heartbreak, shutouts, and bad BABIP/LOB% luck — not blowouts or garden-variety GIDPs.
stat.formula: (3×one-run losses + 2×walk-off losses + extra-inning losses + shutouts + golden sombreros) ÷ games with feed + (0.300 − BABIP)×5 + (LOB% − 72)÷20
